title: A role with all permissions off blocks the user from every feature
custom_preconds:
1. A custom role 'Zero Permissions' has every box and toggle off.
  2. A user is assigned that role.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Look at the landing page.
  3. Look at the top navigation and the sidebar.
  4. Try to open Work Orders, Schedule, Customers, Parts and Reports.
  5. Try opening several feature addresses directly.
custom_expected:
The landing page is minimal (for example just a profile and clock in/out).

No feature navigation is available.

All attempts to reach features are refused.
evidence: UI: a near-minimal custom role (only scheduleView) shows a minimal nav (just Schedule + Clock In); navigating to /reports or /administration/staff is refused and redirects to /schedule. (A truly all-off role cannot be saved — Create is disabled at zero perms, C26335 — so the practical minimum is one feature perm; that user is blocked from every other feature.) screenshot xperm-MinRole.
